rulings.sign:s2.amt_l18_low: s2.amt_l17 is Form 6251 line 17, s2.amt_l6 less s2.amt_l16, and s2.amt_l16 is the smaller of s2.amt_l6 and s2.amt_l15, so it is never more than s2.amt_l6: the amount is zero or more on every return, whatever the sign of line 15.
rulings.sign:s2.amt_l18_product: s2.amt_l17 is Form 6251 line 17, s2.amt_l6 less s2.amt_l16, and s2.amt_l16 is the smaller of s2.amt_l6 and s2.amt_l15, so it is never more than s2.amt_l6: the amount is zero or more on every return, whatever the sign of line 15.
rulings.sign:s2.amt_l31: s2.amt_l30 is Form 6251 line 30, the smaller of s2.amt_l24 and s2.amt_l29. s2.amt_l29 is NonNegDollars (subtract_floor0), and s2.amt_l24 is s2.amt_l22 less s2.amt_l23, where s2.amt_l23 is the smaller of s2.amt_l21 and s2.amt_l22 and so never more than s2.amt_l22: both operands are zero or more, so the amount is zero or more on every return.
